correctness.rationale: The graph-defined group VxZ with bilinear cocycle has commutator edge coordinates x_u y_v-y_u x_v for all prime-power q, including characteristic two. For an ordered pair, hub coordinate pair U=0 forces all spoke targets zero; each blade then has determinant fiber D_q(w)=q^3+q^2-q if zero, q(q^2-1) otherwise. For U nonzero, pick K with det(U,K)=1 and solve A_i=alpha U+u_i K, B_i=gamma U+v_i K; alpha*v_i-gamma*u_i=w_i has q, q^2 or zero solutions according to spoke data. Multiplying independent blade fibers and q^(6m) central-coordinate choices proves the target formula; image count (q^3-q+1)^m+q^m-1 follows by active spoke-support subsets. Any target decomposes into spoke-only and internal-only single commutators; m>=2 has explicit mixed-blade noncommutator so width exactly two versus one for m=1. An independent exhaustive q2,m2 check recovered 52/64 image and zero-target vertex fiber 148. Uniform algebraic proof, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: No claim for arbitrary graph groups or all nilpotent groups.
